Welcome

Restoring Families.
Equipping Communities.

Welcome to the official ministry and leadership platform of Peter Milimo — a place dedicated to restoring families, strengthening faith, equipping communities, and raising a generation grounded in biblical truth and practical skills.

Through biblical teaching, marriage mentorship, Christian leadership, books, and technical empowerment programs, this ministry exists to bring healing, spiritual awakening, and transformation to individuals, families, churches, and communities.

Our Story & Mission
Marriage Restoration

Healing broken marriages and equipping couples to build God-centred homes that thrive.

Christian Leadership

Raising servant leaders who govern with integrity and deep biblical wisdom.

Spiritual Awakening

Igniting a deep hunger for God through prayer, the Word, and revival fire.

Youth Empowerment

Building a generation rooted in biblical truth, purpose, and practical skills.
